{{Quote|Well? You coming or not?|The attendant to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Part I" />}}
A [[Human]] [[Gender|female]] worked as an '''attendant''' at the [[spaceport]] in [[Anchorhead]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. She was checking passengers departing Anchorhead in [[9 BBY]]<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|I}}</ref> when [[Jedi]]-in-[[Exile (punishment)|exile]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] departed for [[Daiyu]] to [[Search for Princess Leia|rescue]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], who had been [[Ambush on Alderaan|kidnapped]] by [[Mercenary|mercenaries]].<ref name="Part I" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The attendant first appeared in "[[Part I]]" of the [[Disney+]] live action television series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi Wan Kenobi'']], directed by [[Deborah Chow]]<ref name="Part I" /> and released on [[May 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Episode 1 Premiere">{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']]|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}}</ref> She was played by [[Sonia Jackson]] and credited as "Attendant."<ref name="Part I" />
